messages:
maria.chen: FYI support just escalated a p99 latency spike for HarborHealth (customer). Started ~03:10 UTC, p99 jumped to ~1.2s for short prompts (<=256 tokens). Throughput looks stable.
jon.patel: any recent deploys around that time? :ear:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026.03.16-48 -> prod at 02:50 UTC (canary -> 10% -> 100%)
leo.nguyen: quick check — are we seeing KV cache hit-rate changes? that's a common cause for short-ctx p99s.
support-ops: attaching snippets from support logs:
```
[2026-03-16T03:11:05Z] request_id=abc123 model=redwood-xl seq=64 ttfb=0.45s
[2026-03-16T03:11:06Z] request_id=def456 model=redwood-xl seq=64 ttfb=1.12s
```
Taylor.brooks: I'll spin up perf on a canary node and grab a few samples. Which node should I hit?
infra-ryan: use canary-10.prod.us-west2 (same pool from deploy-bot output). Also check node-level stats: mem pressure + hugepage counts.
jon.patel: dashboards: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/harbor
jon.patel: I'm seeing KVCache hitrate drop from 98% -> 62% at 03:09-03:12 UTC on that pool.
leo.nguyen: ok that's consistent. Could be a cache invalidation bug in the new release or a change in batching that evicts entries.
Taylor.brooks: running perf/top at 03:20. Command I'm running:
```
ssh canary-10
sudo perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 30
sudo perf script > /tmp/harbor-perf.out
```
in parallel I'll curl a couple of test requests with x-request-id and include traces.
support-ops: please make sure to include these headers in captured requests: `x-customer-id: harbor`, `x-request-id` and `x-rls-snapshot:true`
maria.chen: also capture rpc traces from envoy sidecar and inference runtime. Use trace sampler = 100 for a short window.
infra-ryan: no OOMs on the nodes; kubelet evictions none. kernel logs show a handful of page reclaim events around 03:09 but not full OOM.
leo.nguyen: can someone grep the model-server logs for `kvcache.*evict` around that time? I want eviction counts.
Taylor.brooks: posted perf output and flamegraph link: https://artifacts.redwood/tmp/harbor-flame-179234
jon.patel: flamegraph shows increased time in `kv_lookup` lock path around 03:10, and higher syscalls for `madvise`.
maria.chen: hypothesis: a background GC/compaction or memhint changed layout causing KV cache invalidations -> cache miss storm -> increased compute and syscalls -> p99 spike.
leo.nguyen: can we repro locally by running perfbench with an artificial cache miss pattern? I can try to reproduce with `bench/loadgen --seed missy --cache-size 1GB`.
support-ops: Harbor reported this affected ~12 requests/min around the window, customer impact medium. They are asking for ETA on mitigation.
jon.patel: mitigation options:
- rollback release 2026.03.16-48 (fast but global)
- patch: tighten cache eviction logic + quick canary (slower)
- routing: route Harbor traffic to an older pool (dedicated node from yesterday)
maria.chen: I'll lean rollback for now while we investigate. @eng-sre to approve emergency rollback?
infra-ryan: approving rollback to release/2026.03.16-47 for customer traffic. I'll open a canary-targeted rollback to minimize blast radius.
Taylor.brooks: running a quick reroute test to a warm node. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-router/reroute -d '{"customer":"harbor","target":"warm-2026-03-15"}'
```
support-ops: customer notified and asked to confirm degradation clears; will watch.
maria.chen: action items:
- taylor.brooks: capture perf+flamegraph (in progress) -> posted link
- leo.nguyen: run local repro and attempt a fix for cache eviction logic
- infra-ryan: perform canary rollback/reroute and monitor
- jon.patel: correlate logs/dashboards and collect request IDs for support
Please post artifacts here (perf, logs, grep output). I'll coordinate customer comms.
leo.nguyen: one more data point — replayed a short run with `bench/loadgen` on canary and saw cache hit dips when request pattern changed to many short contexts.
maria.chen: great. I'll leave this thread for async updates. Ping me with the perf artifacts or when rollback completes. :pray:
support-ops: rollback/reroute executed at 03:37 UTC; customer reports p99 back to ~0.12s now. Closing the immediate impact loop, keeping thread open for root cause.
jon.patel: saved artifacts to s3://redwood-artifacts/harbor/1792345678/
leo.nguyen: starting a PR to add an extra safety check in kv eviction (WIP) — will link PR here when ready.
maria.chen: thanks everyone. We'll run a postmortem if RCA points to release bug. For now marking as mitigated.
